Accenture Federal Services LLC, Arlington, Virginia, has been awarded a $151,462,808 firm-fixed-price task order under the General Services Administration Alliant 2 government-wide acquisition contract for intercontinental ballistic missile FENCES engineering services. This task order provides for engineering, development, security, and operations of tailored FENCES, with task order ceiling of $228,000,000 to accommodate future in-scope special project requirements. Work will be performed at Hill Air Force Base, Utah, and is expected to be completed by June 30, 2030. This contract was a sole-source acquisition. Fiscal 2026 research, development, test and evaluation funds in the amount of $6,720,480 are being obligated at the time of award. The Air Force Nuclear Weapons Center, Hill AFB, Utah, is the contracting activity (FA8204-27-F-B001). (Awarded on Oct. 23, 2026).
 
Amentum Technology Inc., Tullahoma, Tennessee, has been awarded a $16,390,078 definitive contract for System Integration Laboratory services. This contract provides secure and reliable access for government and contractor users, cybersecurity infrastructure, and facility security support to enable designated teams to develop, test, and integrate software to support an infrastructure that connects to the North American Aerospace Defense Command (NORAD) Cheyenne Mountain Complex-Integrated Tactical Warning/Attack Assessment (NCMC-ITW/AA) Integration and Development Environment to support the NCMC-ITW/AA and the Legacy Space Command and Control Program Office. This contract ensures continued access to key systems and data necessary for the sustainment and enhancement of NORAD’s mission. Work will be performed primarily in Colorado Springs, Colorado, and is expected to be completed by Oct. 31, 2030. This contract was a sole-source acquisition. Fiscal 2027 operation and maintenance funds in the amount of $3,930,588 are being obligated at the time of award. The Space Systems Command, Peterson Space Force Base, Colorado, is the contracting activity (FA8723-27-C-B001).

Raytheon Co., Woburn, Massachusetts is being awarded a contract modification (P00038) under a previously awarded indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract HQ0147-18-D-0001. This modification provides for a non-competitive, two-year extension and increases the contract ceiling from $2,605,033,000 to $2,999,033,000. The current contract was the result of a sole-source acquisition. Under this contract extension, Raytheon will continue operations and sustainment support for the Army Navy/Transportable Radar Surveillance and Control Model 2 (AN/TPY-2) radar systems, utilizing a combination of cost-plus-incentive-fee, cost-plus-fixed-fee, and firm-fixed-price contract line items. Associated task order extensions reflecting the increase are also being awarded. The work will be performed in Woburn, Massachusetts, and at multiple radar sites inside and outside of the continental U.S. The contract modification will extend the current ordering period an additional two years from Oct. 31, 2026, to Oct. 31, 2028. Fiscal 2027 operations and maintenance, research, development, test and evaluation, and procurement funds totaling $112,309,403 will be obligated at the time of award via task order modification. The Missile Defense Agency, Redstone Arsenal, Alabama, is the contracting activity.
